description: Create a signed, 15-minute, scope-bound quote for EnergyAI’s $1 Power Screen from non-sensitive site and workload facts. Returns the quoteToken required by run_power_screen, exact price, evidence boundary, authorization class, and higher-tier handoffs. Free and never spends funds. [always free — no API key required]

apiKey.description: Optional existing EnergyAI key for hosts that cannot change Authorization headers. Use it to retain account identity for discovery and get_builder_upgrade_link after a trial. Removed before tool execution and persistence. Omit when the Bearer header is attached; never show the key to the user.

flexibilityHours.description: Hours per week the workload can shift.

powerEvidence.description: Buyer-stated evidence maturity; confirmed still requires documentary verification.

siteLocation.description: County/state, balancing area, or approximate site. Do not send a street address or contact information.

stagedMw.description: Optional first-stage load in MW; defaults to the lesser of 4 MW and targetMw.

storageHours.description: Optional available storage duration in hours.

targetMw.description: Target compute or flexible-load capacity in MW.

name: get_power_service_quote
